home.heroBody: Order your favourite dishes for delivery or pickup, and pay in cash when you receive them.

admin.title: Back office
admin.notStaffBody: Your account is not a staff account. Ask the owner to give you a role.
admin.dashboardIntro: This is the Sarhad back office. Orders, menu and delivery zones arrive in the next phases.
admin.addStaffHint: The person must create an account first (website, app or here). Then enter their email.
admin.noAccountForEmail: No account uses that email yet. Ask them to sign up first.
admin.onlyOwnerCanChangeOwners: Only an owner can add or remove owners.
admin.lastOwner: You cannot remove the last owner.
admin.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do that.
admin.mapPinHint: Open Google Maps, long-press the branch, and copy the two numbers. The map editor arrives with delivery zones.
admin.categoryNotEmpty: Move or delete the items in this category first.
admin.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Square photos look best.
admin.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.
admin.noCategories: Create a category first, then add items to it.
admin.modifiersHint: For example Size (choose 1, required) or Extras (choose up to 3).
admin.availabilityHint: Switch items off when they run out, or set a different price for this branch.
admin.onlyManagersPrices: Only a branch manager can change prices.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
admin.zonesIntro: Draw the areas each branch delivers to. Each area has its own delivery fee, minimum order and delivery time.
admin.noZones: This branch has no delivery areas yet.
admin.branchNoDelivery: This branch is set to not offer delivery, so customers will not see these areas until delivery is switched on in the branch settings.
admin.mapHintDraw: Click on the map to add corners. Click the first corner or press Enter to finish.
admin.mapHintEdit: Click a shape to select it, then drag its corners. Drag a middle point to add a corner.
admin.mapShapes: {count, plural, =0 {No shapes drawn} one {1 shape drawn} other {# shapes drawn}}
admin.mapFallback: The street map could not load. You can still draw, but place names are hidden.
admin.otherZones: Other areas of this branch are shown faded.
admin.paymentNeedsKey: Add an API key before showing this gateway at checkout.

payTest.body: This is the built-in test gateway. No real money is taken. Use it to try online ordering before connecting a real gateway.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.intro: Discount codes customers type at checkout. The discount is checked again on the server for every order.
promos.codeHint: Letters and numbers, e.g. RAMADAN10. Customers can type it in any case.
promos.nameHint: Shown to the customer when the code is applied.
promos.confirmDelete: Delete this promo code? Orders that used it keep their discount.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Cash on delivery or pickup is always on. Add an online payment gateway to also take KNET and card payments.

kindHints.myfatoorah: Paste the API token from the MyFatoorah portal: Integration Settings > API Key.
kindHints.tap: Paste the secret key (sk_test_… or sk_live_…) from the Tap dashboard: goSell > API Credentials.
kindHints.test: Lets you try online ordering end to end. It only works when the website allows it (never in production by default).

payments.apiKeyHint: Stored securely. Nobody can read it back, not even admins. Leave blank to keep the saved key.
payments.isLiveHint: Off: the gateway's sandbox with test cards.
payments.confirmDelete: Remove this payment gateway? Past orders keep their payment records.
payments.needsKey: Add an API key before showing it at checkout.
payments.serverNote: The website server also needs SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY set to talk to gateways (see the README).
